about_the_game:
Introduction:

Fractals is a two-player co-op puzzle platformer built around mirrored mechanics and teamwork. Play as two characters going through different levels and solve puzzles where actions on one side could affect the other. Push mirrored crates, change gravity, teleport through portals, and manipulate the environment in unique ways. Each level introduces new mechanics and concepts that build on the mirrored theme, creating increasingly complex and satisfying challenges.

Features:

A Divided World: Each level in Fractals uses mirrors to separate the players into two distinct sides: one of light, the other of dark. However, strangely, each world does not seem to mirror the other perfectly... rather, mirrors act as the sole barrier between light and dark. The players must work together across their respective sides of the mirror in order to complete each level.

Fractal Crates: In this world, the primary interaction between both sides of the mirror will be completed using crates that mimic the movement of another, represented by the color of their central gem. The dark crate will always mirror the movement of its light counterpart, however, the light crate will never move with the dark crate.

Portals: Sometimes, parts of the mirror separating light and dark will destabilize and falter, forming a portal which allows objects from one side to cross and interact with objects of the other side.

There are many other mechanics and features to discover and enjoy!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Internet connection required for multiplayer and cloud features. Offline play supported for local co-op mode.
